faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HNBGU Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Project Assistant position at Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University is 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Forestry, Environmental Science, or Botany to be eligible for the Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 15,000.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the HNBGU Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you send your complete application with all required documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an application screening to shortlist eligible candidates for the Project Assistant role.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position at Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University, not a permanent government job.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University located?
faq.answer: Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University is located in Srinagar Garhwal, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 249161.

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article.
